metadata.description: Janglim is an embeddable LALR parser-generator engine for .NET. Define grammars in C# or EBNF text with typed tokens and registered C# predicates. Preserve token trivia and line breaks, predict two-way Shift/predicate epsilon Reduce conflicts, and inspect tables, FIRST/FOLLOW sets, traces, syntax trees, and diagnostics. Includes grammar validation, incremental reparsing, and pluggable error recovery.
